body.name: Separated tensor minimum-distance fit
body.construction: Let \((\widehat C,\widehat\lambda)\) be the lexicographically selected minimizer of \(\lVert\widehat{\mathcal T}_r-\sum_{j=1}^n\lambda'_j(c'_j)^{\otimes r}\rVert_F\) over normalized pairs \((C',\lambda')\) satisfying the numerical restrictions defining \(\mathfrak P_{p,n,r}(a,\delta,\sigma,\kappa,\Lambda,M)\)
